EDIT TARGET: first image (the newly generated construction atlas) only. STYLE REFERENCE: second image simplified full timber.png is the project's ORIGINAL Mana Seed sheet. Third image spring.png is additional exact pixel-scale and palette reference. Redraw the TARGET atlas as strict Mana Seed pixel art. Critical: this is native LOW RESOLUTION pixel art, EXACTLY 96x96 logical pixels, magnified with nearest neighbor, NOT an illustration that has been pixelated. Maximum 16 colors per material, perfectly square pixels of one consistent size, no gradients, no fine texture, no black thick outlines, no subpixel detail. Same muted salmon and wine-red roof palette, warm brown timber, olive greens and subtle light direction as original Mana Seed. Preserve TRANSPARENCY. Sheet layout exactly SIX columns by SIX rows of 16x16 logical pixels, no gaps, margins, grid lines or labels. REDRAW TOP HALF: create TWO SINGLE CONTINUOUS SEAMLESS roof assemblies, each 48x48 logical pixels, FIRST at columns1-3 rows1-3 (muted red ceramic), SECOND at columns4-6 rows1-3 (muted blue-gray timber). Each entire 3x3 assembly is ONE CONTINUOUS trapezoidal roof viewed orthographically from above with a front eave, in original Mana Seed RPG 3/4 perspective. The diagonal left/right slopes must continue across all three rows, NEVER restart into independent triangles on each row. Central column straight roof texture joins continuously top to middle to bottom. Roof rows touch exactly and have no grass, no black gaps between them; transparent only OUTSIDE roof silhouette. Ridge only at very top edge, front wooden eave only on BOTTOM edge. Draw crisp broad simple pixel clusters like the original tiny Mana Seed roof, not many shiny shingles or repeated chimney-like ridges. BOTTOM HALF: row4 wall top, cols1-3 timber left/center/right; cols4-6 plaster/timber left/center/right; row5 foundation wall left/center/right for both materials, perfectly continuous without transparent strips between cells. Use understated wood slats with just 1-pixel shading and low-contrast irregular small stones, no detailed high-resolution stone blocks. Row6 transparent objects: column1 one wooden closed door16x16, column2 alternative wooden door16x16 with small iron latch and threshold, column3 warm simple square window16x16; column4 plaster-surround closed door16x16, column5 alternative plaster door16x16, column6 window with tiny flowers16x16. No houses or NPCs. Do NOT copy the reference sheet; create NEW matching artwork. Every object must fit its cell and every repeated center tile must fill the cell width completely, with NO transparent left/right padding. All existing target roof flaws and shiny high-resolution texture MUST be replaced.

Baixa resolução real e só16x16 pixels por célula, SEM detalhes menores, SEM antialias, SEM gradientes, SEM textura pintada. As4células das colunas3-4 linhas1-2 juntas formam UMA BANCA32x32 pixels de feira com toldo creme/vermelho e frutas, transparente fora do objeto.
